output: html_document

```{r,echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)

# Read the data
df <- read.xlsx("E://narration//5.Property transaction//property_transactions_1750066258149.xlsx")
colnames(df) <- make.names(colnames(df))

# Ensure TRANSACTION.DATE is in Date format
df$TRANSACTION.DATE <- as.Date(df$TRANSACTION.DATE)

# Determine data period dynamically
date_range <- range(df$TRANSACTION.DATE, na.rm = TRUE)
start_date <- format(min(date_range), "%d %B %Y")
end_date <- format(max(date_range), "%d %B %Y")

# Calculate highest-value transactions
highest_trans <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(VALUE..SAR.)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2) %>%
  mutate(
    rate_per_sqm = PROPERTY.TRANSACTION.RATE..SAR.sqm.,
    area_sqm = TRANSACTION.AREA..sqm.,
    value_sar = format(VALUE..SAR., big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
    zone_text = ifelse(is.na(ZONE), NEIGHBORHOOD, ZONE),
    prop_type = ifelse(is.na(PROPERTY.TYPE.ESTATER), "Unknown", PROPERTY.TYPE.ESTATER)
  )

# Extract details for first and second highest transactions
first_trans <- highest_trans[1, ]
second_trans <- highest_trans[2, ]

first_value <- first_trans$value_sar
first_area <- first_trans$area_sqm
first_area <- format(first_area, scientific = FALSE, big.mark = ",")
first_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", first_trans$rate_per_sqm)
first_zone <- first_trans$zone_text
first_prop_type <- first_trans$prop_type

second_value <- second_trans$value_sar
second_area <- second_trans$area_sqm
second_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", second_trans$rate_per_sqm)
second_zone <- second_trans$zone_text
second_prop_type <- second_trans$prop_type

# Calculate average rate per sqm by neighborhood
neighborhood_rates <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(NEIGHBORHOOD), !is.na(PROPERTY.TRANSACTION.RATE..SAR.sqm.)) %>%
  group_by(NEIGHBORHOOD) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rate = mean(PROPERTY.TRANSACTION.RATE..SAR.sqm., na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_area = mean(TRANSACTION.AREA..sqm., na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_rate)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3)

# Extract top neighborhoods
top1_neigh <- neighborhood_rates$NEIGHBORHOOD[1]
top1_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", neighborhood_rates$avg_rate[1])
top1_area <- sprintf("%.0f", neighborhood_rates$avg_area[1])

top2_neigh <- neighborhood_rates$NEIGHBORHOOD[2]
top2_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", neighborhood_rates$avg_rate[2])

top3_neigh <- neighborhood_rates$NEIGHBORHOOD[3]
top3_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", neighborhood_rates$avg_rate[3])

# Calculate transaction volume by neighborhood
trans_volume <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(NEIGHBORHOOD), PROPERTY.TYPE.ESTATER == "Residential Building" | PROPERTY.TYPE.AS.PER.GOVERNMENT.RECORD == "land") %>%
  group_by(NEIGHBORHOOD) %>%
  summarise(
    trans_count = n(),
    avg_rate = mean(PROPERTY.TRANSACTION.RATE..SAR.sqm., na.rm = TRUE),
    min_rate = min(PROPERTY.TRANSACTION.RATE..SAR.sqm., na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rate = max(PROPERTY.TRANSACTION.RATE..SAR.sqm., na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(trans_count)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2)

# Extract details
most_trans_neigh <- trans_volume$NEIGHBORHOOD[1]
most_trans_count <- trans_volume$trans_count[1]
most_trans_min_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", trans_volume$min_rate[1])
most_trans_max_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", trans_volume$max_rate[1])

second_trans_neigh <- trans_volume$NEIGHBORHOOD[2]
second_trans_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", trans_volume$avg_rate[2])

# Calculate block performance
block_stats <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(BLOCK)) %>%
  group_by(BLOCK) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rate = mean(PROPERTY.TRANSACTION.RATE..SAR.sqm., na.rm = TRUE),
    total_value = sum(VALUE..SAR., na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_types = n_distinct(PROPERTY.TYPE.ESTATER, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_value)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3)

# Extract block details
block1 <- block_stats$BLOCK[1]
block1_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", block_stats$avg_rate[1])
block1_value <- format(block_stats$total_value[1], big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)

block2 <- block_stats$BLOCK[2]
block2_value <- format(block_stats$total_value[2], big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)

block3 <- block_stats$BLOCK[3]
block3_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", block_stats$avg_rate[3])

# Summarize by zone
zone_stats <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(ZONE)) %>%
  group_by(ZONE) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rate = mean(PROPERTY.TRANSACTION.RATE..SAR.sqm., na.rm = TRUE),
    trans_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_rate))

top_zone <- zone_stats$ZONE[1]
top_zone_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", zone_stats$avg_rate[1])
```

The Riyadh real estate market is entering a transformative phase influenced by ongoing infrastructure projects, Vision 2030 objectives, and dynamic population growth. ## Scenario 2: Moderate / Steady Progress

**Assumptions:**
- Incremental but steady completion of infrastructure and policy initiatives.
- Sustained but tempered demand for mid-market residential units.
- Gradual zoning reform consistent with current municipal plans.

**Implications:**

## Scenario 3: Pessimistic / Slowdown

**Assumptions:**
- Delays in major infrastructure developments.
- Macroeconomic headwinds affecting local disposable income.
- Policy shifts leading to regulatory uncertainty.

**Implications:**
- Slower growth in premium property segments.
- Residential market performance reliant on affordability and demand for essential housing.

**Recommended Strategy:**
- Prioritize liquidity: avoid overcommitment to large premium projects.

- Actively monitor municipal planning developments to stay ahead of regulatory risks.

The most prudent approach under current market conditions is a diversified strategy—balancing premium segment exposure in neighborhoods like `r top1_neigh` with solid residential developments in demand-driven zones such as `r most_trans_neigh`. Investors and developers are encouraged to maintain flexibility, hedge against downside risks, and capitalize on emerging opportunities where infrastructure and policy converge to shape Riyadh’s long-term real estate success.
